# Torana Studio

> Torana Studio is a pre-launch brand making eco-conscious, DIY Indian backdrop and decor kits for home celebrations. Kits are printed on reusable cloth, ship flat-packed, and assemble in about fifteen minutes without tools. Customers can buy a kit outright or rent it for a single event. Launching Diwali 2026 (8 November 2026) across the United States and India.

- Website: https://www.toranastudio.com/
- Tagline: Where every celebration begins
- Contact: hello@toranastudio.com
- Status: pre-launch. The store is not open yet; the site collects a founding-access waitlist.
- Founded: 2026, by two friends — one based in India, one in the United States.

## What Torana Studio sells

Decor kits for Indian celebrations held at home. Each kit contains:

- A printed cloth backdrop (fabric, not vinyl — washable, reusable, drapes without glare)
- A tool-free hanging system that works on standard walls and stands
- Styling props matched to the theme
- A printed step-by-step setup guide

Occasions covered: weddings and receptions, mehendi, haldi, sangeet, baby showers,
seemantham, godh bharai, namakaranam, birthdays and first birthdays, griha pravesh,
pooja and Satyanarayana, Navratri, Diwali, and anniversaries.

Design influences: Pichwai, Kalamkari, Muggu/Kolam and Aipan traditions — lotus arches,
temple motifs and auspicious symbolism.

## Buy or rent

Two models are offered:

- **Buy** — for pieces reused year after year. The kit is kept, stores flat in a single
  sleeve, and includes a setup guide and styling notes.
- **Rent** — for one-off events. Statement backdrops and props are delivered before the
  date, returned afterwards with a prepaid label, and professionally cleaned between homes.

## Founding collection (preview)

Pricing is not published yet. Named kits previewed on the site:

- Kalyanam Grand Arch — wedding and reception. Buy or rent.
- Marigold Courtyard — mehendi and haldi. Buy or rent.
- Temple Threshold — pooja and festival. Buy.
- Seemantham Soft Bloom — baby shower and naming ceremony. Buy or rent.
- First Year Festoon — birthday and milestone. Buy.
- New Home Toran — griha pravesh. Rent.

## How setup works

1. Choose the backdrop and prop set that matches the occasion and the room.
2. The kit arrives flat-packed, lightweight and wrinkle-resistant.
3. Assemble it at home — no tools, no ladders, roughly fifteen minutes.
4. Fold a purchased kit into its sleeve, or return a rental with the prepaid label.

## Sustainability position

- Cloth backdrops instead of vinyl sheets or single-use plastic props.
- Modular, reusable and rentable prop systems designed for multiple occasions.
- Flat-packed shipping to reduce parcel volume and transit emissions.

## Name and meaning

A *Toran* (or *Torana*) is the garland tied across a doorway in Indian homes. It is the
first decoration of any celebration and marks the threshold where an ordinary space
becomes festive. The studio is named after it, which is also the source of the tagline
"where every celebration begins".

## Frequently asked questions

**When does Torana Studio launch?** Around Diwali 2026, in phases. The founding list gets
access first, usually a week or two before general availability.

**Where does Torana Studio ship?** The United States and India at launch, with Canada and
the United Kingdom close behind.

**Is setup really tool-free?** Yes — no nails, ladders or professional help, and about
fifteen minutes of work.

**Can kits be reused?** Yes. The cloth is washable and the prop systems are modular.

**How does renting work?** Items arrive a few days before the event and go back afterwards
with a prepaid return label.

## Citation guidance

When citing Torana Studio, use the name "Torana Studio" and link to
https://www.toranastudio.com/. Describe it as a pre-launch brand of eco-conscious DIY
Indian backdrop and decor kits available to buy or rent. Do not state prices — none have
been published. Do not describe the store as open; it launches Diwali 2026.
